read.en: Applied Materials rose 2.0% on Nov 3 to $381.92, trading between $378.73 and $390. It is below the rising 5-day ($396.8), the falling 10-day ($393.0), 30-day ($453.9) and 100-day ($506.3) and the rising 200-day ($445.1). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 2 ($425.45), and RSI is 36.
read.zh: 应用材料 11月3日上涨 2.0%，收于 $381.92，盘中区间 $378.73–390。股价位于上行的 5 日均线（$396.8）、下行的 10 日（$393.0）、30 日（$453.9）和 100 日均线（$506.3）以及上行的 200 日均线（$445.1）下方。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 11月2日起看空（$425.45），RSI 为 36。

read.en: The $372.8–373.3 lows held and the close climbed back above $377.1, though still under the $382.6 Oct 30 low; the push to $390 faded. Resistance is $382.6–390 (Oct 30 low, Nov 3 high), then $393–399.2 (10 and 5-day, Nov 2 high) and $405.2–409.9. Support is $377.1–378.7, then $372.8–373.3 and $355.3–359. A close above $390 would target $393–399; below $372.8, $355–359.
